input.jdText: Backend Junior: build Node.js REST APIs with PostgreSQL. Explain transactions, concurrent updates, idempotency and integration testing.
input.cvText: Synthetic candidate built a Node.js inventory service using PostgreSQL transactions and integration tests. No identifying information.

history.question: How would you prevent two concurrent purchase requests from overselling the last inventory item?
history.answer: I would use an atomic UPDATE with quantity >= requested quantity in its WHERE clause, check the affected row count and create the order in the same transaction. A unique idempotency key prevents a retried request from creating a second order. In a concurrent integration test I would start two transactions against one remaining item and verify that only one order commits and stock never becomes negative.
